title: Commit: fix(census): exclude private repositories from CI census via documented EXCLUDED_PRIVATE_NO_CI_ACCESS
content:
fix(census): exclude private repositories from CI census via documented EXCLUDED_PRIVATE_NO_CI_ACCESS

demo-repository is the only private repository in the organization
(verified via API). The CI census cannot clone it because the workflow
credential lacks private-repository access (Issue #112), which kept the
scanner-tests check red on every head.

Fail-closed exclusion, not a silent omission:
- manifest: 'private': true recorded for demo-repository
- run_org_source_census.py: a private repository without a checkout is
  recorded as EXCLUDED_PRIVATE_NO_CI_ACCESS with residual
  PRIVATE_REPOSITORY_EXCLUDED_NO_CI_ACCESS, counted in the new summary
  key active_excluded_private, and excluded from missing_active.
  Status formula: scanned + excluded_private must equal active_expected.
- a private repository WITH a checkout (local run with credentials) is
  still scanned normally: 26/26, 0 excluded, unchanged.
- tests: +3 (excluded-not-blocked, scanned-when-present, mixed-manifest
  keeps other failures blocking), 14/14 pass.
- docs: catalog exclusion section + audit record R-1 mitigation.

Simulated CI (no demo checkout): census RESIDUAL exit 0, 25 scanned +
1 excluded, 0 blocked; reconcile RESIDUAL, 0 blocking findings.
Full local census: RESIDUAL, 26/26 scanned, 0 excluded.

Note: the required 2-line workflow assertion edit is NOT included here
(agent OAuth token lacks workflow scope, GH013) and is documented as an
owner action in the audit record R-1.

Agent-Task: census-private-exclusion
AI-Role: ci-agent
Validation: unittest 14/14; census sim exit 0; reconcile 0 blocking
